description: Look up 2026 upload specs for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat and Threads: aspect ratio, resolution, max length, file size, caption and hashtag limits, each row with official source links, plus recent spec changes. Use it before exporting or cropping a video for a platform. Offline data, no network calls; empty filters return every row.

format.description: Format filter, substring: Reels, Stories, Feed, Shorts, Long-form, Spotlight ... Empty = all formats of the platform.

platform.description: Platform name filter, case-insensitive substring: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, Threads. Empty = all platforms.
